itens.resumo: Cat Tien National Park, which is on the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)’s Green List of Protected and Conserved Areas, is expected to become a major tourist attraction, helping promote green economic development and strengthen the tourism brand of southern Vietnam’s Dong Nai province.
